title: Anuel AA Joins Lineup for the 2026 iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina on October 17 at Kaseya Center in Miami, Florida
summary: iHeartMedia is a leading global media and entertainment company specializing in radio, digital, mobile, social, live events and on-demand entertainment.
body_markdown:
*Tickets are available now at TicketMaster.com*


*The 2026 iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina event will broadcast across iHeartRadio Latin stations nationwide*


**WHAT:** iHeartMedia announced today that **Anuel AA** will join the lineup for 2026 iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina, celebrating the power of Latin music with a star-studded slate of performances at Kaseya Center in Miami, Florida on Saturday, October 17.


**WHO:** Hosted by Enrique Santos, president of iHeartLatino and iHeartRadio personality, the 2026 iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina event will feature performances by **Anuel AA, Myke Towers, Blessd, Farruko, Manuel Turizo, Eladio Carrión, FloyyMenor, Greeicy, Alleh and Rey Tony Y Helabusador “Los Titis.”** This year’s event will also honor Lin-Manuel Miranda with the 2026 iHeartRadio Corazón Latino Award.


**WHEN:** Saturday, October 17, 2026


**WHERE:** Kaseya Center (601 Biscayne Blvd, Miami, FL 33132)


**MORE:** Tickets are available now at[TicketMaster.com](https://www.ticketmaster.com/event/0D0064C58CC07B23)


iHeartMedia’s Spanish Contemporary Hits, Tropical, Regional Mexican, Tejano and Spanish Adult Hits radio stations will broadcast the event live in markets across the country and on the iHeartRadio app. Additionally, the iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina will broadcast across iHeartRadio digital stations including Beso, El Patron, Salsa Bembe, Rumba, Reggaeton Vieja Escuela, La Preciosa, Tejano Radio, La Mezcla Fuego con Dj Xtreme, Latino Top 20, Tropical Top 20 and Regional Mexican Top 20.


Proud partners of this year’s event include Audible and Goya Foods with more to be announced.


For more information, visit iHeartRadio.com/fiesta.


*Artists and/or event are subject to change or cancellation without notice.*
